name: small-parabola-validation-256
purpose: Independent synthetic validation inputs frozen before candidate evaluation; these are not camera photographs.

profiles.support: u=(x-3.5)/(size-7), evaluated only for 0<=u<=1; shape=0 outside that range
profiles.circular-arch: sqrt(max(0,1-(2*u-1)^2)); continuous with zero endpoints and unbounded endpoint derivatives

geometry: For each fixed axial coordinate x, forward y'=h+y*(1-h/size), h=sign*amplitude*shape. Sampling uses its exact inverse y=(y'-h)/(1-h/size). Each bounded |shape|<=1, |h|<=5 and size>=49, so denominator>=44/49; coordinate inversion is valid. Axis x swaps coordinates before and after mapping. Zero outside profile support may make derivatives discontinuous; this is an artificial raster fixture.
raster: Six module quiet-zone pixels at the chosen scale; two by two subpixel samples, each at cell quarter and three-quarter positions; black=25, light=230; floor average, then horizontal mirror, clockwise quarter-turn rotations, then optional inversion.
payload: Throwaway SMALL-PARABOLA-VALIDATION-{index}- prefix plus 24 deterministic lower-case alphanumeric characters; LCG seed 0x3b19e72d mixed with the case index; bounded length fits the minimum version and ECC combination.
transformAssignment: ECC uses index plus floor(index/4) and floor(index/16), modulo 4; rotation uses floor(index/4) modulo 4; inversion uses floor(index/16) modulo 2; mirror uses floor(index/32) modulo 2. Rotation and ECC are not fixed by profile index alone.
freezeRequirements: Before any candidate evaluation, independently hash generator and every pixel array and payload, record complete metadata and assert all 256 are mutually unique and disjoint from the previous 1120-case corpus by both pixel and payload hash. Freeze manifest and source binding; any collision or mismatch fails the gate.
status: Source declaration only; cases have not been generated or evaluated by its author.
